body.statement: Construct the finite procedure \(\mathsf A(T,S,B,(|\mathcal X_t|)_{t=1}^T)\) from the interval-block certificate handle and prove the following exhaustive alternative on every positive support-and-rank branch. Either it returns an evaluable map \(\mathsf{Rec}_{T,S,B}\) satisfying \(\mathsf{Rec}_{T,S,B}((M_d)_{d=0}^T)=Q(P)\) for every compatible \(P\), or it returns two laws \((P,P')=\mathsf{Wit}_{T,S,B}\) in \(\mathcal P_{T,S,B,e}\) such that \(\Phi_{T,S,B,e}(P)=\Phi_{T,S,B,e}(P')\) and \(Q(P)\ne Q(P')\). The obstruction compiler must preserve strict positivity, the first-order substantive Markov factorization, every local parent set \(S_t\), and every audit table \(M_d\), and the proof must hold for arbitrary \(T\) and the specified alphabet sizes.
body.justification: This is the answer-open mathematical kernel: it must unify rational normalization, rank-free curvature recovery, alphabet-sensitive branches, endpoint-only cancellations, and positive countermodel gluing.
body.gap: Tikka and Karvanen provide separate sufficient recoveries and one passive obstruction; no published result gives a complete partial-audit recovery-or-obstruction alternative for a restricted substantive Markov chain.
body.consumer: A longitudinal study designer can certify whether historical chart or survey variables in each dropout stratum suffice for the endpoint treatment contrast before fielding the audit.

obligation.what_is_open: An explicit finite interval-block state space, an exhaustive list of recovery and obstruction rules, a termination proof, and a positive countermodel-gluing theorem for arbitrary \(T\) and every local-parent interaction remain to be constructed.
obligation.obstruction: The frozen certificate handle is a research program rather than a definition of \(\mathsf A\): it specifies neither the finite states nor a rule deciding every residual state. Positive scaling can identify a target on singular strata, while interacting parents can preserve all overlapping audit margins and still change the endpoint. The supplied four-visit witness rules out the natural path-coverage closure, and no argument supplied in the core proves that the listed normalization, transport, curvature, and rank branches exhaust all response fibers.
obligation.attempted: I verified pattern-table equivalence and the local Markov-tail factorization, then tested the proposed closure architecture against the single-informative-hazard construction, complementary positive-scaling logic, alphabet-sensitive rank branching, and the stated four-visit parent-interaction counterexample. These establish sound individual moves but do not yield a residual-state dichotomy or a gluing induction.
obligation.partial_result:
The two foundational reductions are complete: randomized auditing is
exactly equivalent to observing the pattern tables, and every dropout
subdensity has the stated two-step boundary followed by an unselected
Markov suffix.  In addition, the single-informative-hazard subclass has a
complete arbitrary-horizon recovery-or-positive-witness alternative, as
proved in the partial result for that proposition.  These results certify
pattern marginalization, risk-set addition, legal positive normalization,
and Markov-tail transport.  They do not establish that the proposed list
of operations is exhaustive when several local hazards interact.
